title: codemother's stage and verdict gates chart a queued ticket
intention: CodeMother holds a gate for each chart stage (orient, constrain, survey, decompose, triage, hypothesize, validate) and one for the verdict, each answering machines/<stage>/queueme <fileref>: it reads that stage's draft off the ticket's plan, fills the ticket claim and the earlier stage's berth as the ref (orient also its floor facts), writes the packet through the stage's own door, records the berth on the ticket, posts it to her deposit verb and answers passed true; a missing draft, a missing earlier berth or a door refusal fails the ticket to FIXME and answers passed false with the lacks. The verdict gate disposes each hypothesis from the observed run of its own instrument, never from the draft.
why: Outline 9.6 (Akien 2026-11-10, Q#81): each chart stage and the verdict is a gate machine that answers queueme <fileref>, and the ticket class queues itself to each in turn (Ticket.chart, cd8a1de6139c); 3.3.4.3: the gate instantiates the ticket on its own side. Measured 2026-11-11: shim.declared_machines registers watchme and clearance only; the one chart driver is cairn/devices/cc/scripts/chart_ticket.py importing her seven stage machines, and cairn/devices/cc/scripts/verdict_ticket.py writes every disposition 'confirmed'.
traces_to: Outline 9.6 and 3.3.4.3 (Q#81 answer); RULE 1 — the chart is reached through CodeMother's gates, not her code; Law 8 — a disposition is observed, never self-graded.
how: A new machine cairn/devices/codemother/machines/chart_gate/ (charter, gate.py, proofs) holds StageGate(stage) for the seven stages and the verdict, and gates() builds all eight; shim.declared_machines merges them beside watchme and clearance. The clearance gate's owning-intention journal derivation becomes clearance/gate.py journal_of(ticket, roots), read by both. A red-first proof drives the gates over a scratch tickets store, a scratch packets dir and a spy participant.

clauses.claim: StageGate('orient').queueme({body: {fileref}}) over a ticket whose plan carries chart.orient writes one packet into the packets dir carrying ticket equal to the ticket's id and the floor's domain, records its path as orient_berth in the ticket's chart_claim, posts {berth} to codemother verb deposit, and answers accepted true and passed true with that berth

StageGate('constrain').queueme after the orient pass writes a packet whose intent_ref equals the recorded orient_berth and whose constraints equal the draft's, and records constrain_berth beside orient_berth

StageGate('survey').queueme over a ticket with no chart.survey draft, and StageGate('survey') over a ticket with a draft but no constrain_berth, each answer accepted true and passed false with a lack naming what is absent, write no packet, and leave the ticket's cursor where it stood with the lacks as its fixme, and ask design to queue it

a constrain draft the door refuses (constraints empty) answers passed false with a lack carrying the door's ConstrainRefused words, writes no packet and leaves the ticket's cursor where it stood with the lacks as its fixme, and asks design to queue it

StageGate('verdict', runner=...) over a ticket whose validate and hypothesize berths stand, whose draft carries a disposition 'confirmed' for every hypothesis, and whose injected runner exits 1 for one hypothesis's instrument and 0 for the other's, berths a verdict disposing the first killed and the second confirmed, each by naming its instrument and exit

chart_gate.gates() carries the eight stages orient, constrain, survey, decompose, triage, hypothesize, validate, verdict each with declared_verbs {queueme}, and cairn/devices/codemother/shim.py declared_machines merges gates() beside watchme and clearance

Ticket.failed over a ticket standing at TICKETME (before FIXME's BUILDME anchor) crosses nothing and journals nothing: the cursor is unchanged, the lacks land as the ticket's fixme, no harbor post is made, and design is asked to queue it

decisions.text: D1: write the charter cairn/devices/codemother/machines/chart_gate/intention+why.json through the artifact door (verb cast) before BUILDME, and an empty __init__.py docstring module beside it.

D2: chart_gate/gate.py: STAGES maps each stage to (module, writer, ref key, previous stage): orient (orient, write_packet, None, None), constrain (constrain, write_constrain, intent_ref, orient), survey (constrain_ref, constrain), decompose (survey_ref, survey), triage (decompose_ref, decompose), hypothesize (triage_ref, triage), validate (hypothesize_ref, hypothesize), verdict (verdict, write_verdict, validate_ref, validate). The writer is imported at call time from cairn.devices.codemother.machines.<module>.<module>.

D3: StageGate(stage, *, participant=None, roots=None, packets_dir=None, runner=None).queueme(envelope) reads body.fileref, Ticket.at(fileref, tickets_dir, roots); packet_of(ticket) is the draft dict plus ticket=id plus ref_key=Ticket.berth(prev); orient also takes floor_packet(request)'s domain and refs where the draft's are None and prepends its unknowns. A lack (no draft, no earlier berth, or a RuntimeError/ValueError/OSError/KeyError from the door) goes to Ticket.failed (which, before BUILDME, stands and asks design: D8)(lacks, participant, actor='codemother', **journal_of(ticket, roots)) and answers {accepted: True, passed: False, lacks}. A pass calls Ticket.berthed(stage, berth), posts {berth} to codemother verb deposit, and answers {accepted: True, passed: True, berth}.

D4: the verdict gate disposes each hypothesis of the chain's hypothesize berth (read through the validate berth's hypothesize_ref) from a run of that hypothesis's OWN instrument: verdict.extract_command(instrument), then the gate's runner (the door's run_instrument by default) once per distinct command; confirmed iff it exited 0 and did not time out, killed otherwise, by '<command> exited <n>'; an instrument with no runnable command is a lack. The draft's dispositions are replaced; the criteria are run by write_verdict as ever, handed the same runner.

D5: clearance/gate.py gains module function journal_of(ticket, *, roots=None) -> {history_path, state_path}, the owning-intention resolution crossing_of did inline (repo, then commons, then an absolute path); crossing_of calls it.
D6: shim.declared_machines returns {'watchme': ..., 'clearance': ..., **chart_gate.gates(participant=Voice(self._bus))}; chart_gate.gates(*, participant=None) builds a StageGate per STAGES key.

D7: the red-first proof cairn/devices/codemother/machines/chart_gate/proofs/test_the_stage_gates_chart_a_ticket.py builds a scratch tickets store (live store charter copied in, ticket_file._TICKETS pointed there) holding a fixture whose id is this ticket's own (so the doors' on-file claim check resolves), a scratch packets dir, and a spy participant; one tooth per falsifier clause, binding the gate inside each tooth.

D8: Ticket.failed asks _before_repair(workflow) — does the cursor stand before the anchor of the workflow's FIXME repair summons, read from the registered workflow emit reads? If so it crosses nothing: it writes the lacks as fixme, asks design to queue it and returns the workflow unchanged; otherwise it kicks back to FIXME as before. Proved by a tooth in cairn/machines/ticket/proofs/test_a_ticket_queues_itself_at_a_gate.py keyed to this ticket's clause 7.

both proofs resolve the commons beside-else-home when no sibling stands: transitions' class table (_NODE_CLASSES and the emit/load_class_def kwdefaults) and, in the gate proof, grammar.ticket_path's tickets_dir default; predicted green in a commons-less git worktree 2026-11-11

measured.saw: declared_machines returns watchme and clearance only; chart_ticket.py imports the seven stage machines; verdict_ticket.py sets disposition 'confirmed' for every hypothesis; every stage door's refusal class subclasses RuntimeError
measured.how: sed -n 143,149p cairn/devices/codemother/shim.py; cat cairn/devices/cc/scripts/chart_ticket.py cairn/devices/cc/scripts/verdict_ticket.py; grep '^class .*Refused' cairn/devices/codemother/machines/*/*.py

measured.saw: the verdict door's readings are one per CRITERION (observe_instruments iterates verdicts), it refuses a 'pass' whose re-run disagrees, and unanswered() kicks back a criterion reporting 'fail'; so a hypothesis disposed from a criterion's reading could never be killed on a berthable verdict, and the gate must run each hypothesis's own instrument

clauses 3 and 4 red with 'IllegalTransition: FIXME is entered from BUILDME or later': a ticket charts at TICKETME, and the repair summons FIXME is anchored before BUILDME, so Ticket.failed's kick-back cannot fire there; outline 3.3.4.3 says only 'on a fail it asks design to queue it'
measured.how: bin/cairn test --exec on the proof; transitions.py:1388-1393
